title: Assessing Bias in Metric Models for LLM Open-Ended Generation Bias Benchmarks
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype-related bias detection against specific religious groups, evaluated by prepending religious descriptors to sentences and measuring the response of various bias metric models.
findings: The study found that bias metric models exhibit varied biases towards religious groups. RegardV3 was the most biased classifier, showing strong negativity towards 'Atheists' and 'Jews'. In contrast, DistilBERT was more uniform, while Detoxify and VaderSentiment showed more balanced responses across the religious groups tested.
